## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Container build or runtime behavior was checked when Docker-related files changed
- [ ] README/configuration/dashboard documentation was updated when user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Metric names, types, units, and labels remain backward compatible, or the breaking change is documented

## Security

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private device responses, or private network addresses are included
